refund_policy: Autopay and auto-debit refunds are processed within 5-7 business days. Refunds are credited back to the original payment method.
bill_dispute_policy: Bill disputes must be raised within 30 days of the bill date. Our team will review and respond within 3 business days.
outage_policy: Reported outages are escalated to the network team immediately. Resolution time is typically 4-24 hours depending on severity.
contact_info: For urgent issues, call 1-800-TELECOM (Mon-Sat, 9AM-6PM). For non-urgent matters, email support@telecom.example.com.
privacy_note: We never ask for OTP, passwords, or full card numbers. Beware of phishing attempts.
